instructions.mission: Synthesize multi-LLM code review findings and apply fixes

steps.step: Cross-reference findings from all code reviewers. Verify validity of each finding by examining the actual code. Note areas of consensus and disagreement.
Check each finding against the actual codebase. Document false positives with explanation.
Order fixes: Critical > High > Medium > Low. Group related fixes together.
Apply validated fixes using Edit tool. Run pytest after each group of fixes. Revert if tests break.
Only refactor files already modified by applied fixes. Keep refactoring scope minimal and targeted.

Examine project root for build system indicators and determine commands for lint, typecheck, build, test, and integration test:
- package.json + lockfile: package-lock.json=npm, pnpm-lock.yaml=pnpm, yarn.lock=yarn Commands: {pkg_mgr} run lint, {pkg_mgr} run typecheck, {pkg_mgr} run build, {pkg_mgr} test - pyproject.toml / setup.py: pip/poetry/uv + pytest/ruff/flake8/mypy Commands: ruff check, mypy, pytest, python -m build (vary by config) - pom.xml: Maven Commands: mvn compile, mvn test, mvn verify - build.gradle / build.gradle.kts: Gradle Commands: gradle build, gradle test, gradle check - Makefile: make Commands: make lint, make test, make build (examine Makefile targets) - Cargo.toml: Rust/Cargo Commands: cargo check, cargo clippy, cargo build, cargo test
Store detected commands for use in step 7. If no recognizable build system found, note this and skip automated verification.

This is the master-only (single-provider) phase — safe for command execution.
Using detected toolchain commands, run full runtime verification:
1. Lint Check: Run detected lint command - If lint fails, fix issues introduced by applied fixes - Do NOT fix pre-existing lint issues unrelated to review fixes 2. Type Check: Run detected typecheck command - Fix type errors introduced by applied fixes 3. Build: Run detected build command - Verify project builds successfully 4. Test Suite: Run full test suite (detected test command) - All tests must pass - If tests fail, determine if failure was caused by applied fixes - Revert fixes that caused test failures 5. Integration Tests: Run detected integration test command (if applicable) 6. Runtime Smoke Check: Verify app starts without errors (if applicable)
BLOCKING: If any verification fails due to applied fixes: - Identify which fix caused the failure - Revert that specific fix - Document as "Fix attempted but caused regression — reverted" - Re-run verification after revert
Record all verification results for the synthesis report.

Create report with: - Applied fixes with before/after - Rejected findings with rationale - Reverted fixes with regression details (if any) - Quality metrics - Runtime verification results: | Check | Status | Notes | |-------|--------|-------| | Lint | Pass/Fail | | | Type Check | Pass/Fail | | | Build | Pass/Fail | | | Unit Tests | Pass/Fail (X/Y passed) | | | Integration Tests | Pass/Fail/N-A | | | Runtime Smoke | Pass/Fail/N-A | | - Test results after fixes (pass/fail summary) - Final quality assessment
